evidence_classes.name: PRESERVED_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE

evidence_classes.name: EXTERNAL_MUTABLE_OBSERVATION
evidence_classes.meaning: A provider, deployment, or production dashboard reported a time-indexed state outside this bound worktree.
evidence_classes.maximum_claim: The exact external snapshot contains the reported observation, subject to recheck.

evidence_classes.name: JOINED_RUN_EVIDENCE
evidence_classes.meaning: One authorized exact execution is transactionally bound to its frozen design, identity, ordering, outcomes, and packet.
evidence_classes.maximum_claim: The exact joined run occurred under its admitted protocol.

evidence_classes.name: INDEPENDENT_SCIENTIFIC_VALIDATION
evidence_classes.meaning: Independent numerical replay, controls, falsifiers, held-out replication, construct/causal review, and claim-language review are complete.
evidence_classes.maximum_claim: Only the exact reviewed scientific statement within its scope.

evidence_classes.name: WORM_AND_TRUSTED_ORDERING
evidence_classes.meaning: Exact-version retained bytes, retention state, trust root, time/order, nonce, and one-use transitions are independently verified.
evidence_classes.maximum_claim: Only the exact retained object/version and ordering facts covered by the receipt and policy.

evidence_classes.name: PRODUCT_AUTHORITY
evidence_classes.meaning: Current live product, security, operations, commercial, privacy, compliance, support, incident, and human acceptance gates are satisfied.
evidence_classes.maximum_claim: Only the exact approved product statement at the exact current deployment identity.

evidence_classes.name: LICENSE_CANON_DISCLOSURE_AUTHORITY
evidence_classes.meaning: Explicit qualified authorities approve an exact claim, canon transition, or release package and wording.
evidence_classes.maximum_claim: Only the exact scoped decision recorded by the relevant authority.
